subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite PR #41067, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or declare the existing partial reconnect mitigations sufficient for #38091?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but choosing the active-run reconnect contract and whether to reuse the stale candidate PR crosses protocol, session-state, and user-visible interruption semantics.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the recovery intent while using current filtered active-run, protocol-package, and restart lifecycle contracts.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The PR author can update #41067 against current main and add redacted live Dashboard reconnect proof before another merge review.

options.title: Accept partial mitigations only
options.body: Maintainers can decide queued-send and Stop visibility mitigations are enough, but should then close or split the remaining terminated-run reports explicitly.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the recovery intent while using current filtered active-run, protocol-package, and restart lifecycle contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice spans the Gateway protocol package and session lifecycle surfaces where recent history points to steipete as the best available routing owner.
